Summarise tidy trajectories across draws

Source: R/samples.R
summarise_trajectories.Rd

Collapse a tidy tibble of trajectories to a mean, median and central interval at each time, ready for ggplot2::geom_ribbon(). The summary is taken over draws, chains and particles; every other column (variable, time, group, array dimensions and any columns you have added, such as a scenario) is kept as a grouping.

Usage

summarise_trajectories(data, interval = 0.95)

Arguments

data

A tibble from tidy_trajectories(), tidy_simulation() or tidy_filter().

interval

Width of the central interval, by default 0.95.

Value

A tibble with the grouping columns and mean, median, lower and upper.
